targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM proxies WHERE active = true AND rotation_status = 'Rotated' AND location IN ($location)
SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM proxies WHERE active = true AND rotation_status = 'NoRotation' AND location IN ($location)
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(rotation_count), 0) as value FROM proxies WHERE active = true AND last_rotation_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) AND location IN ($location)

SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE_FORMAT(last_rotation_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:00')) as time_sec, COUNT(*) as rotation_count FROM proxies WHERE active = true AND $__timeFilter(last_rotation_at) AND last_rotation_at IS NOT NULL AND location IN ($location) GROUP BY time_sec ORDER BY time_sec
SELECT rotation_status as metric, COUNT(*) as value FROM proxies WHERE active = true AND location IN ($location) GROUP BY rotation_status

panels.title: Proxies with High Same IP Count (Potential Rotation Issues)

targets.rawSql: SELECT name, location, last_ip, same_ip_count, rotation_count, rotation_status, last_rotation_at, updated_at FROM proxies WHERE active = true AND same_ip_count >= 10 AND location IN ($location) ORDER BY same_ip_count DESC LIMIT 20

list.name: location
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT location FROM proxies WHERE location IS NOT NULL
